title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Equal III
summary: Choose one element per operation. Multiply by any integer k>=2, or divide exactly by an integer 2<=k<the current element. Return the fewest operations making all elements equal. The statement does not bound intermediate values or provide a finite target candidate list. Original input bounds must not be imposed on intermediate values.
